name: The Eldest's Stilt-House
story: Tallissa has buried more of Isseva in the water than lives on it now, and keeps a lantern lit on the jetty rail for each one she buried herself, which is a lot of lanterns and a lot of oil.
who_was_here: Four generations of Ouls, and the water, twice, in bad years.
unique_object: a rail of forty lantern hooks facing the burial water, every one of them lit
